indicator_definition: General government consolidated gross debt as a percentage of GDP. Reflects fiscal sustainability and capacity to finance public investment. Data compiled by Eurostat under the Excessive Deficit Procedure.
rationale: Sustainable public finances are essential for long-term development investment. Progress means maintaining debt at levels consistent with fiscal sustainability.
methodology_characteristics: Data compiled by Eurostat under the Excessive Deficit Procedure (EDP). Published twice yearly for all EU member states and candidate countries.
indicator_name: Government debt as share of GDP
graph_title: Government debt as share of GDP
